evidence.observation: Pressure steady near 3.01-3.03 Torr through the ramp and early growth.
Pressure has risen steadily from 3.03 to 3.36 Torr over 480 s of growth, about 0.1 Torr every 120 s, and is still rising.
Argon flow is steady at about 100 sccm, so extra argon does not explain the rise.
Temperature is holding at 750 °C and heater power is normal, so the heating side looks fine.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, but the growth stage requires one to verify the atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading or a leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with the pump isolated would show whether this is air leaking in (seal leak) or a partial exhaust blockage. Checking the pump/exhaust line and valve position would also help.
